Rules:

6. If Bob is not young and Bob is not cold then Bob is round.

Goal: Determine if Bob is green.

We need to derive Bob's attributes.

From facts: Bob is kind, Bob is smart, Bob is not nice, Bob is not round.

We also have rule 5: All kind things are young. Since Bob is kind => Bob is young.

Rule 1: All young things are cold. So Bob is young => Bob is cold.

Rule 2: Cold things are green. So Bob is cold => Bob is green.

Thus Bob is green follows.

But we need to check if any contradictions or other rules might block? Let's see.

We have rule 3: If something is kind and not smart then it is green. Bob is kind and smart, so antecedent false, no info.

Rule 4 about Erin.

Rule 6: If Bob is not young and Bob is not cold then Bob is round. But we have Bob is young (so not not young) and Bob is cold (so not not cold). So antecedent false (Bob is not young is false, Bob is not cold false). So rule 6 gives nothing.

Thus no contradictions. So Bob is green is derived.

Thus answer True.
